name: Get DESIGN.md
summary: Turns any public URL into a full-page PNG and an implementation-ready DESIGN.md with tokens, components and source asset links.
description: A web tool by The Weekend Company: paste a public URL and it opens a managed browser, captures a 1440px full-page screenshot and analyses the rendered design into a DESIGN.md — color tokens, typography, spacing, composition, components, motion and responsive rules, with direct source links for the visual assets. Public pages only.
